propositions: A new advisory code-review overlay named surface-parity must be added to the four-pass code-review gate to detect when a write-op parameter, guard, or required field changes on one adapter (lib, CLI, or MCP) without corresponding updates to sibling adapters.

The surface-parity overlay must be glob-triggered on write-surface files (_commands/, _lib_writes.py, _mcp_writes.py) and remain inert on unrelated diffs, wired into both round_a and round_b batches so the finder is actually dispatched.

The overlay must be advisory (blocking_enabled=false, block_threshold=0.95) with false-positive guards for deliberate justified divergence, adapter-bound params, and internal-only refactors, preventing spurious findings on compliant or intentionally divergent changes.

The overlay prompt must carry the deletion-impact/api-compat contract (evidence-record findings, criteria: [surface-parity], no model-emitted severity) and instruct the reviewer to grep sibling adapters for changed params/guards.

The overlay membership, routing, glob firing, and dispatch behavior must be verified by unit tests asserting OVERLAY_IDS membership, routing entry shape, threshold resolution to (0.95, False), and actual finder dispatch on write-surface diffs.

The base-reviewer overlay catalog must list surface-parity to keep the drift gate test_base_prompt_enumerates_exactly_the_overlay_ids green, and index.json must remain unchanged (overlays excluded from the selection catalog).
